subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Acceptance Criteria Deep Dive
description: Learn Acceptance Criteria Deep Dive in one minute.

hook.text: The product owner says 'the search should be fast.' The developer delivers in 3 seconds. The PO wanted 300ms.

buildup.text: Vague acceptance criteria lead to different interpretations and rework when expectations don't match.

discovery.text: Good criteria are specific and testable: 'search returns results within 300ms for up to 1,000 records.'

twist.text: Writing testable criteria forces the team to agree on scope, performance, and edge cases upfront.

climax.text: Clear criteria turn acceptance testing from a debate into a checklist. Pass or fail, no ambiguity.

punchline.text: If you can't test the criterion, it's not a criterion.
